actual_access: Host account filesystem and localhost access; lane-only writes instructionally constrained, not OS-contained.
independent_desired_outcome: Old reviews match only their trace ID and canonical hash.
Independent same-scope reviewer disagreements remain separate observations.
Latest amendment supersedes a decided verdict while original event and correction provenance remain durable.
Stale amendments fail without persistence; unchanged restart preserves current state.

attempts.hypothesis: Carry an old review into a changed output across restart.
attempts.baseline: HTTP 200 legitimate save and unchanged restart restored matching original.
attempts.actions: Save original synthetic diagnostic review; change copied probability 0.9 to 0.91; restart; POST old hash; POST existing review ID with new hash; save distinct new observation; restore original bytes; restart.

old_hash.error: Trace changed or is outside this review snapshot

reassignment.error: An existing review cannot be reassigned to another trace version

attempts.persisted_state: Two separate version-bound review events; original-only matching state after reset.
attempts.reset_evidence: Scratch source restored byte-identically; external source hash unchanged.

attempts.hypothesis: Collapse reviewer disagreement or leave a superseded FAIL current across amendments/restart.
attempts.baseline: Zero observations initially; legitimate A FAIL/B PASS saves both HTTP 200 and both current.
attempts.actions: Save separate same-scope synthetic FAIL/PASS observations; amend FAIL to DEFER; attempt stale save; restart unchanged paths.

stale_amendment.error: Review changed in another tab; reload before saving

attempts.persisted_state: Three append-only records; original prefix and correction supplier retained; two latest observations DEFER/PASS after restart.
attempts.reset_evidence: Source copy unchanged; restart current records equal; external source hash unchanged.

limitations: Direct trusted ReviewServer HTTP/persistence path; CLI startup and browser rendering unverified.
Current GET excludes amendment history; full provenance inspection requires JSONL history as documented.
Trace snapshots are hashed, not archived by the helper; original retained in this run, so no irreversible loss reproduced.
Reviewer identities and labels are synthetic/self-reported; no domain truth, expert authority, product performance, semantic calibration, or full-skill pass-rate conclusion.
No end-to-end Create Eval authoring grader exists; helper acceptance is not full skill credit.
